claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: Photos show only the unit itself, no shop signage, stock range, or origin marking (e.g., JDM export sticker) to confirm dealer status or Japanese sourcing.

risks.risk: Unknown vehicle make/model/year of origin, so fitment cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Clear shot of the ID/VIN-style tag or part number stamped on the casing
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified/generic fitment, lowest matching bracket

risks.risk: Automatic vs manual transmission not stated
risks.proof: Wide shot showing shifter linkage/mechatronic valve body or clutch bellhousing detail distinguishing type
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower-value/ambiguous type until confirmed

risks.risk: Internal condition (gears, clutch plates, fluid, wear) unknown; dust/grime obscures leaks
risks.proof: Video of unit being turned by hand/bench-tested showing smooth rotation and fluid drain
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested, worst-case possible internal fault

risks.risk: Completeness uncertain – loose wires and open ports suggest missing sensors/solenoids or torque converter
risks.proof: Close-up of torque converter still mounted and full connector set with no missing plugs

risks.risk: Reason for removal unknown (could be accident or failure)
risks.proof: Photo/video of the donor vehicle or removal history document

risks.risk: No warranty or testing evidence provided
risks.proof: Any receipt, warranty card, or bench-test video from seller
risks.if_unproven: priced as sold as-is, no warranty

proof_requests: Photo of the part/ID number plate or casing stamp
Video of the gearbox being rotated or bench-tested
Confirmation shot of torque converter and all sensor connectors attached
Any documentation on the donor vehicle or removal reason
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a used transmission/gearbox assembly with starter motor, so it can be priced at worst case for an untested, unidentified-fitment unit pending further proof.
